units.title: Introduction to the Piano and Proper Posture
units.learning_objective: By the end of this unit, the learner will be able to identify key parts of the piano and demonstrate correct sitting posture and hand position at the keyboard.

units.title: Navigating the Keyboard: White and Black Keys
units.learning_objective: By the end of this unit, the learner will be able to locate and name all C, D, E, F, G, A, B notes on the white keys across the keyboard using patterns of black keys.

units.title: Basic Finger Numbers and Five-Finger Exercises
units.learning_objective: By the end of this unit, the learner will be able to correctly apply finger numbers to each digit and play a C major five-finger scale ascending and descending with both hands independently.

units.title: Reading Music Fundamentals: Treble Clef, Staff, and Quarter Notes
units.learning_objective: By the end of this unit, the learner will be able to identify the treble clef, understand the staff lines and spaces, and recognize quarter notes and their duration.

units.title: Playing Simple Right-Hand Melodies from Notation
units.learning_objective: By the end of this unit, the learner will be able to read and play simple 4-bar melodies in the treble clef using quarter notes, C, D, E, F, G, with the right hand.

units.title: Reading Music Fundamentals: Bass Clef and Half/Whole Notes
units.learning_objective: By the end of this unit, the learner will be able to identify the bass clef, locate common notes on the bass clef staff, and recognize half notes and whole notes and their durations.

units.title: Playing Simple Left-Hand Melodies from Notation
units.learning_objective: By the end of this unit, the learner will be able to read and play simple 4-bar melodies in the bass clef using quarter and half notes, C, B, A, G, F, with the left hand.

units.title: Introduction to Basic Piano Chords (Triads)
units.learning_objective: By the end of this unit, the learner will be able to identify and form major triads (C, G, A minor, E minor, D minor) in root position with the left hand.

units.title: Hand Coordination: Simple Two-Hand Pieces
units.learning_objective: By the end of this unit, the learner will be able to play a simple 8-bar piece with both hands simultaneously, where one hand plays a melody and the other plays a single-note accompaniment.

units.title: Learning the Canon Chord Progression (Left Hand)
units.learning_objective: By the end of this unit, the learner will be able to accurately play the repeating 8-chord progression of Pachelbel's Canon in D with the left hand.

units.title: Learning the First Melody Phrase of Canon (Right Hand)
units.learning_objective: By the end of this unit, the learner will be able to play the first 8-measure melodic phrase of Canon in D with the right hand, recognizing the notes and rhythm.

units.title: Combining Hands: First Section of Canon
units.learning_objective: By the end of this unit, the learner will be able to play the first 8 measures of Canon in D with both hands, coordinating the left-hand chords with the right-hand melody.

units.title: Learning Subsequent Melody Phrases of Canon (Right Hand)
units.learning_objective: By the end of this unit, the learner will be able to play the next two melodic phrases (approx. 16 measures) of Canon in D with the right hand.

units.title: Combining Hands: Extended Sections of Canon
units.learning_objective: By the end of this unit, the learner will be able to play the first three combined sections (approx. 24 measures) of Canon in D with both hands, maintaining rhythm and coordination.

units.title: Practicing and Performing the Full Canon in D
units.learning_objective: By the end of this unit, the learner will be able to play a simplified version of the entire Canon in D, demonstrating accurate notes, rhythm, and coordination between both hands.
